summary: Named spine lifecycle: Spine supports rename() (stem only, .jsonl appended). Spine can be opened from any path (independent location). SchemaToucherWindow supports Spine > Rename Spine menu item. Reopen from a different path works via Spine.open().
decision_or_outcome: Spine.rename() updates _path in-place and renames the file. SpineError raised if target exists. SchemaToucherWindow._rename_spine() calls spine.rename() and updates the header. open_schema_toucher() in app.py accepts an optional path= kwarg to open a specific spine on launch.
